chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Hearing the New Orleans Rhythm Kings at Friars Inn
summary: He hears George Brunis and Rappolo's band with Dixieland arrangements, and does not meet Brunis until years later.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: So, all right now -- so, you were working and tell about the Seattle Harmony Kings now-- that happened next - right?
Well, yes - but not for a--- quite a little while -- right in there - I was still jobbing around Chicago and I---
It was a matter of weeks though - correct?

Yeah - it was a matter of weeks but I -- there used to be a place called "The Friers Inn" -- and that was near my hotel and I remember going down there one night just to see what was down there -- and, believe what was down there -- the New Orleans Rhythm -- Kings - with George Brunis and oh, man, I heard that band -- I couldn't believe it - you know ---
That was the first time you encountered Brunus---
Yes and that band - with Rapola on the clarinet ---
They had Rapola who ended up in a mental institution---
And, they had these wonderful Dixie Land arrangements - you know - and, oh, ---
Who else was in the band now - Brunis and Rapola---
I don't remember--- LaRocca -- no - LaRocca was with the others - he was with the original Dixie Land Jazz Band - but I don't remember. I do remember those two guys. You know. And---
Did you get--- did you become friends with Brun's then or did that happen later?
No -- I never got to meet him then - never met him until years later.
